# Larch

> Larch is a free, open-source AI engine from Arkaya Labs that runs open models
> (Llama 3.x, Mistral, Qwen 2.5, Qwen 3, Qwen 3.5) on your own Mac or PC (macOS, Windows and Linux). It has a
> built-in agent, a desktop app and a local API compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic.
> Apache 2.0. The agent and desktop app are in preview.

## On this site
- [Install](https://larch-engine.com/#install): one command for macOS, Windows and Linux. Version 0.1.0 is out for Apple silicon Macs; the Windows and Linux builds follow soon
- [Documentation](https://github.com/Arkaya-Labs/Larch/tree/main/docs): install, quickstart, hardware, models, the agent, the HTTP API
- [Release notes](https://github.com/Arkaya-Labs/Larch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Local API](https://larch-engine.com/#developers): `larch serve`, OpenAI and Anthropic endpoints
- [Questions](https://larch-engine.com/#faq): price, privacy, hardware, models, comparisons

## Elsewhere
- [Benchmarks](https://arkaya-labs.com/research): Larch against llama.cpp, Ollama, MLX and vLLM
- [Source code](https://github.com/Arkaya-Labs/Larch)
